name: Nightbound
source:
Step into the world of the supernatural and encounter monsters, the fae, werewolves, you name it! But beware, nothing is as it seems... 

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Nightbound]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
踏入超自然的世界，与怪物、妖精、狼人等种种奇异生灵相遇吧！不过千万小心，眼前的一切都没有看上去那么简单…

[摘自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Nightbound]Choices维基[/url]]
